headline: Dominican Republic and Japan Launch RD$4.2 Billion Agricultural Project
summary: The Dominican Republic launched a RD$4.2 billion investment project backed by Japan to strengthen agricultural value chains, food processing, distribution, and marketing.
why: Bilateral development funding in agricultural infrastructure aims to boost productivity and modernize food supply chains.

impacts.name: Dominican Republic
impacts.why: Agricultural modernization investments improve supply chain efficiency and rural economic output.
